program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((comps (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))
                      (lambda (a b) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
         (target (list-ref comps (quotient (length comps) 2)))
         (shape (normalize-cells (obj-cells target)))
         (trans (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (first p))) shape)))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells trans)))
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb)) 0) trans 6)))
